name: Marlin: FP16xINT4 LLM inference kernel (GitHub: IST-DASLab/marlin)
notes: Marlin GitHub repository. FP16xINT4 mixed-precision matmul kernel for LLM inference. Claims near-ideal 4x speedups up to batchsizes of 16-32 tokens. Includes benchmark results on A10 GPU and Llama2 models. Requires CUDA >= 11.8, NVIDIA GPU with compute capability >= 8.0 (Ampere or Ada). The paper is arXiv:2408.11743.
